# Generated by ppc worldbuilder: vanilla file patched so fleets sent over the open sea never target a river channel; do not edit by hand.
circumnavigation_expedition = {

	unique = yes
	repeatable = no
	travel_speed = 1
	origin = closest_non_rural_port
	travel_mode = sea
	show_start_message = no

	waypoints = {
		northern_fuerteventura_coast
		pititinga_coast
		frio_cape
		la_plata_river_mouth
		lomas_bay
		colcolo_bay
		puka_puka_coast
		caroline_coast
		pago_bay
		samar_sea
		dadinga_bay
		good_hope_cape
		ponta_grande
	}

	variables = {
		provisions = {
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/unit_view/food.dds"
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			change_format = "VARIABLE_CHANGE_FORMAT"
			monthly_change = {
				subtract = {
					desc = "EXPEDITION_PROVISIONS_TRAVEL_DRAIN"
					value = 0
					if = {
						limit = {
							expedition_is_traveling = yes
						}
						add = 3
					}
				}
			}
		}
		morale = {
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/flat_icons/navy_morale.dds"
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			change_format = "VARIABLE_CHANGE_FORMAT"
			monthly_change = {
				subtract = {
					desc = "EXPEDITION_MORALE_LOW_PROVISIONS"
					value = 0
					if = {
						limit = {
							expedition_is_traveling = yes
							var:provisions < 50
						}
						add = 5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_ships = {
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/control_groups/navy.dds"
			start = 5
			min = 0
			max = 5
		}
		cargo = {
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_cloves.dds"
			start = 0
			min = 0
		}
	}

	potential = {
		capital = { region = region:iberia_region }
	}

	can_start = {
		has_advance = open_sea_exploration
		has_non_rural_port = yes
		discovered_any_in_americas_trigger = yes
		has_discovered_area = area:moluccas_area
		any_subject = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation }
		any_owned_location = {
			is_port = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes
			is_core_of = root
		}
	}

	leader = {
		is_explorer = yes
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
		}
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_port = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes
				is_core_of = root
			}
			order_by = {
				value = modifier:harbor_suitability
				multiply = -1
			}
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = departure_port_scope
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			set_variable = { name = circ_survival value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:departure_port_scope }
				add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_port_scope
			}
			else = {
				add_new_waypoint = root.capital
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:departure_port_scope }
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = departure_port value = scope:departure_port_scope } }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:expedition }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:expedition = { var:num_ships <= 0 } }
				fail_expedition = scope:expedition
			}
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			remove_variable = circ_monthly_event_claimed
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					var:morale < 50
					NOT = { has_variable = circ_mutiny_cooldown }
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = 50
					subtract = scope:expedition.var:morale
					min = 1
				}
				scope:expedition = { set_variable = circ_monthly_event_claimed }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.18
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					var:provisions < 55
					NOT = { has_variable = circ_monthly_event_claimed }
					NOT = { has_variable = circ_scurvy_done }
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = 55
					subtract = scope:expedition.var:provisions
					min = 2
				}
				scope:expedition = { set_variable = circ_monthly_event_claimed }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.21
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = circ_monthly_event_claimed }
				}
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = circ_tempest_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.22
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = circ_worm_done } }
						scope:location = { climate = tropical }
					}
					trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.23
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = circ_becalmed_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.24
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						scope:expedition = {
							has_variable = circ_in_pacific
							NOT = { has_variable = fish_shoal_done }
						}
					}
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.12
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = spoiled_stores_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.13
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						scope:expedition = {
							var:provisions < 50
							NOT = { has_variable = circ_resupply_cooldown }
							NOT = { has_variable = circ_in_pacific }
						}
						scope:location = {
							any_neighbor_location = { is_land = yes }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:location = {
								any_neighbor_location = {
									is_land = yes
									exists = owner
									owner = { NOT = { is_enemy_of = root } }
								}
							}
						}
						trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.28
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							scope:location = {
								any_neighbor_location = {
									is_land = yes
									has_owner = no
								}
							}
						}
						trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.27
					}
				}
				6 = {}
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = {
			discover_location = root
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:northern_fuerteventura_coast }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:pititinga_coast }
			if = {
				limit = { location:potiguara = { top_owner ?= root } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.19
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location:potiguara = { exists = owner } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.20
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:frio_cape }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:la_plata_river_mouth }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:lomas_bay }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:colcolo_bay }
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = circ_in_pacific }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.7
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:puka_puka_coast }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.8
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:caroline_coast }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.9
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:pago_bay }
			scope:expedition = { remove_variable = circ_in_pacific }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:samar_sea }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.11
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:dadinga_bay }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:good_hope_cape }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.13
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:ponta_grande }
			if = {
				limit = { location:fogo = { top_owner ?= root } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.14
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location:fogo = { exists = owner } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.15
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.16
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = circumnavigation_completed } }
			add_prestige = prestige_radical_bonus
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = first_circumnavigation
				days = 10950
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = circumnavigation_completed value = 1 }
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		if = {
			limit = { scope:expedition = { var:num_ships >= 3 } }
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:expedition = { var:morale >= 60 } }
			custom_tooltip = circumnavigation_expedition_high_morale_prestige_tt
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:expedition = { var:morale < 20 } }
			custom_tooltip = circumnavigation_expedition_low_morale_prestige_tt
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					has_variable = cargo
					var:cargo > 0
				}
			}
			add_gold = {
				value = scope:expedition.var:cargo
				multiply = "capital.market.market_price(goods:cloves)"
			}
			capital.market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					amount = scope:expedition.var:cargo
					goods = goods:cloves
				}
			}
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			remove_variable = circ_survival
			remove_variable = provisions
			remove_variable = cargo
			remove_variable = morale
			remove_variable = num_ships
			remove_variable = circ_mutiny_cooldown
			remove_variable = departure_port
			remove_variable = circ_scurvy_done
			remove_variable = circ_tempest_done
			remove_variable = circ_worm_done
			remove_variable = circ_becalmed_done
			remove_variable = circ_resupply_cooldown
			remove_variable = circ_in_pacific
		}
	}

	on_fail = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = circ_voluntary_retreat } } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = circumnavigation_expedition_events.17
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			remove_variable = circ_survival
			remove_variable = provisions
			remove_variable = cargo
			remove_variable = morale
			remove_variable = num_ships
			remove_variable = circ_mutiny_cooldown
			remove_variable = departure_port
			remove_variable = circ_scurvy_done
			remove_variable = circ_tempest_done
			remove_variable = circ_worm_done
			remove_variable = circ_becalmed_done
			remove_variable = circ_resupply_cooldown
			remove_variable = circ_in_pacific
		}
	}

	ai_chance_to_check = {
		value = define:NAI|EXPEDITION_DEFAULT_CHANCE_TO_CHECK
		if = {
			limit = { any_character = { has_trait = navigator } }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}

	utility = {
		value = 20
	}

	leader_utility = {
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = navigator }
			add = 5
		}
	}
}
